nodes.label: _BuildMetaBackend
nodes.desc: PEP 517 hooks bound at module tail; run_setup execs setup.py in a controlled namespace with sys.argv rewritten.

nodes.label: setup()
nodes.desc: Installs setup_requires through MinimalDistribution, then calls distutils.core.setup which resolves to the setuptools Distribution.

nodes.label: DistutilsMetaFinder
nodes.desc: Meta-path shim inserted at the front of sys.meta_path that redirects 'import distutils' to the local copy unless SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS=stdlib.

nodes.label: fetch_build_egg
nodes.desc: Legacy fetch of build eggs into the .eggs cache used by setup_requires.

nodes.label: Distribution
nodes.desc: Subclass of distutils Distribution with _DISTUTILS_UNSUPPORTED_METADATA, validators, version/license normalization and entry-point-driven finalize_options.

nodes.label: _static markers
nodes.desc: Str/List/Dict subclasses that tag values parsed from static config so normalization can preserve their static-ness.

nodes.label: _entry_points.load
nodes.desc: Converts entry-point declarations into validated EntryPoint collections used by check_entry_points and the command registry.

nodes.label: ConfigDiscovery
nodes.desc: Auto-discovery of packages/modules (flat vs src-layout) bound as dist.set_defaults and deferred until run_command.

nodes.label: pyprojecttoml
nodes.desc: read_configuration/apply_configuration for pyproject.toml with schema validation and _EnsurePackagesDiscovered.

nodes.label: setupcfg
nodes.desc: setup.cfg parser producing ConfigMetadataHandler and ConfigOptionsHandler with dash/underscore normalization warnings.

nodes.label: expand.read_attr
nodes.desc: Resolves dynamic attributes: file: reads, attr: AST-based lookup via StaticModule, glob and cmdclass resolution.

nodes.label: _apply_pyprojecttoml
nodes.desc: Field-by-field applier mapping [project] keys onto Distribution attributes with _PREPROCESS dispatch.

nodes.label: command registry
nodes.desc: Import side-effects append the 'egg' bdist format, keeping both dict and list forms of format_commands working.

nodes.label: egg_info
nodes.desc: Metadata pivot: egg_info.run writes PKG-INFO, requires.txt, entry_points.txt; manifest_maker extends sdist for SOURCES.txt.

nodes.label: editable_wheel
nodes.desc: PEP 660 editable builds; _StaticPth, _LinkTree and _TopLevelFinder strategies per strict/lenient mode.

nodes.label: bdist_wheel
nodes.desc: In-tree wheel command: python/abi/platform tag computation plus WheelFile writing via vendored wheel.

nodes.label: build
nodes.desc: Build command that records SubCommand protocol objects so extensions can attach build steps.

nodes.label: build_py
nodes.desc: Byte-compiles and copies package modules, includes package_data globs and guards against include_package_data abuse.

nodes.label: build_ext
nodes.desc: Extension builder with abi3 suffix handling and compiler customization for shared libraries.

nodes.label: sdist
nodes.desc: Source distribution with revision-control aware file listing via walk_revctrl.

nodes.label: dist_info
nodes.desc: Produces the .egg-info/.dist-info directory consumed by prepare_metadata_for_build_wheel.

nodes.label: namespaces.Installer
nodes.desc: Installs namespace package __init__ handling; reused by editable_wheel._NamespaceInstaller.

nodes.label: distutils Distribution
nodes.desc: Local distutils copy: Distribution at line 108 and DistributionMetadata at 1135, patched at runtime by setuptools.

nodes.label: distutils setup()
nodes.desc: setup() at line 79 and run_setup() at 203: parse args, construct Distribution, run command sequence.

nodes.label: distutils Command
nodes.desc: Base Command class every build command inherits: option parsing, reinitialize_command, run_command.

nodes.label: _core_metadata
nodes.desc: Metadata 2.x writer/readers patched onto DistributionMetadata: write_pkg_file, read_pkg_file, get_fullname.

nodes.label: patch_all
nodes.desc: Replaces distutils.core.Command, Distribution and Extension across distutils.dist/core/cmd at import time.

nodes.label: vendored wheel
nodes.desc: Wheel 0.46.3 vendored inside setuptools; bdist_wheel imports WheelFile from it rather than from an external wheel install.
